description:
All-in-one ebook reader

Koodo Reader is an all-in-one eBook reader for Windows, macOS, Linux, and the web, supporting over 15 formats.
New Features
- Support for exporting notes, highlights, and new vocabulary in JSON format
- Support for re-importing notes, highlights, and new vocabulary in JSON and CSV formats; go to Settings > Data
- Optimized rendering speed when handling large numbers of notes and highlights; no more lag issues
- Support for using AI to extract book titles and author names from filenames; right-click on a book and select “Edit Book”
- Support for using AI to parse book titles and authors from filenames when importing books; go to Settings > General
- Supports caching full-text translation and OCR results; books will load directly from the cache the next time they’re opened
- Added Paragraph Mode, Reading Ruler, and Speed Reading Mode; enable them in the reading options panel on the right
- Supports streaming parsing of CBZ and CBT books; no longer requires loading the entire book into memory, significantly improving book import and opening speeds
- Online book metadata matching now includes publication date, ISBN, ratings, and other information
- Copying text from books now preserves the original text formatting
- Added 100 curated book and app background images; go to Settings > Background Images
- Added 11 public domain dictionaries; go to Settings > Local Dictionaries
- Added export progress tracking for batch book exports
- Supports searching for books using a book key
- Restored support for custom TTS plugins, with added security warnings
- Experimental support for total page count; enable this in the reading options panel on the right
- Added page number display to the book table of contents, please enable total page count first
- The official AI dictionary now supports more target languages
- Added a “Return” button after navigating to a section via the inb-book table of contents
- (Mobile) The iOS version now supports accessing the system dictionary, system translation, and system OCR; go to Settings > Third-Party Services
- (Mobile) Optimized import and opening speeds for large CBZ files
- (Mobile) Added a dedicated comic mode for CBZ format, supporting streaming rendering
- (Mobile) Added support for batch downloading books; tap the three dots at the top of the home screen and select “Batch Operations”
- (Mobile) Optimized the chart UI for reading statistics
- (Mobile) Support for custom translation and TTS APIs; go to Settings > API Settings
- (Mobile) Added a “Return” button after navigating to a section via the in-book table of contents
- (Mobile) Expanded the font size adjustment range
- (Mobile) Support for adjusting the paragraph spacing threshold and title size threshold for text-based PDFs when converting to texts
- (Mobile) Optimized rendering speed for books with extensive notes and highlights; stuttering issues have been resolved
- (Mobile) Support for using AI to extract book titles and author names from filenames; long-press a book and select “Edit”
- (Mobile) Support for using AI to extract book titles and author names from filenames when importing books; go to Settings > General Options
- (Mobile) Support for caching full-text translation and OCR results; books will be loaded directly from the cache the next time they are opened
- (Mobile) Added Paragraph Mode, Reading Ruler, and Speed Reading Mode; enable these in Settings on the book page
- (Mobile) Online book metadata matching now includes publication date, ISBN, ratings, and other information
- (Mobile) Added 100 curated book background images
- (Mobile) Support for searching books using a book key
- (Mobile) Experimental support for total page count; go to Settings > Reading Options
- (Mobile) Page numbers are now displayed in the book table of contents, please enable total page count first
- (Mobile) The official AI dictionary now supports more target languages
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where word pronunciations did not match after pinning the dictionary window to the right
- Fixed an issue where deletion and replacement rules did not work for TTS
- Fixed an issue where books could not be imported from the cloud
- Fixed an issue where double-clicking a book in a folder to import it did not work
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where custom fonts did not take effect in certain cases
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where the Back button did not work in certain cases on Android
- (Mobile) Fixed a font size issue on iOS in landscape mode
- (Mobile) Fixed PDF rendering issues in two-page mode
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where deletion and replacement rules did not work for TTS
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.
